purpose: Machine-readable IP-preservation firewall for Program B. Consumed by tests/test_ip_preservation.py. Program B may add instrumentation via optional observer interfaces, detached diagnostic tensors, evaluation-only intervention adapters, and separate evidence modules. Program B may NOT delete, rename, flatten, replace, or genericize Aeon's proprietary architecture. Every invariant here is asserted by the test file — the manifest and the tests move together.

K_locked_at_16.rationale: Slow-clock interval K=16 is the L-series' entire windowing basis. Any change invalidates the barrier registry, the reaction-coordinate framework, and every prior W10 evidence row.

declarations: aeon/hybrid.py::HybridModel.forward: s_w.float(), t_w.float(), e_w.float() at slow-clock tick
recursion_fp32.rationale: The contractive certificate (σ<margin) is proved in fp32. Downcasting Recursion state breaks the certificate.

single_broadcast_per_window.declaration: aeon/hybrid.py::HybridModel.forward: inject_cols.append(h_cond) inside the per-window loop, one h_cond value per token in [start:end]
single_broadcast_per_window.rationale: Adding a second broadcast head or letting the substrate see a different h than the transformer breaks Aeon's cross-stream integration invariant.

forbidden_edges.explanation: Transformer state may reach substrate ONLY via Recursion's h_cond broadcast.
Substrate state may reach transformer ONLY via Recursion's h_cond broadcast + transformer.inject.

no_direct_stream_to_stream_communication.rationale: Removing this invariant collapses the two-stream architecture to a conventional attention+state model.

substrate_gate_inputs.declaration: aeon/hybrid.py::HybridModel.forward: substrate.step consumes only (emb_in + cond_in). No transformer entropy, logits, or attention heads feed the substrate gate.
substrate_gate_inputs.rationale: V0.02.02 patch: transformer entropy cannot enter the substrate gate.

six_v0_02_02_patches_active.rationale: The six V0.02.02 corrections define Aeon's correctness envelope. Program B may not disable any of them.

forbidden_program_b_changes: Deleting or renaming aeon/hybrid.py, aeon/recursion.py, aeon/transformer.py, or aeon/substrate/
Replacing HybridModel with a standard transformer plus memory
Replacing RecursionJoiner with a generic recurrent layer, mixture-of-experts, or state-space model
Making K adaptive or removing the K=16 declaration
Adding transformer entropy, logits, or attention state to substrate gate inputs
Adding a direct transformer↔substrate edge that does not pass through Recursion
Copying proprietary Aeon code into third-party packages
Uploading source, weights, activations, checkpoints, or corpus data to external APIs
Adding telemetry, analytics, or cloud-inference dependencies to the runtime
Placing Aeon architecture internals in public release notes
Extending the corpus license or third-party notice files over Aeon source (Aeon and corpus licences remain disjoint)
permitted_program_b_changes: Adding aeon/bypass/* modules that never modify the default forward path
Adding an optional `observer=None` keyword argument to HybridModel.forward that is inert unless supplied
Adding an optional `intervention=None` keyword argument to HybridModel.forward that is inert unless supplied AND raises when model.training is True (evaluation-only)
Adding tests, evidence modules, benchmarks, and reports under aeon/bypass/, tests/, docs/latent_bypass/, benchmarks/latent_bypass/
Adding validation machinery for a vendored corpus package under corpus_package_tools/ or equivalent

no_ip_export_stance.corpus_package_isolation: Corpus source, license, provenance, and partition manifest live in a separate package (corpus-package/). Corpus licence text NEVER extends over Aeon source, weights, algorithms, checkpoints, or generated evidence.
